change: Add one controlled composition case using the actual Core guarded scene tick, real Store identity/Conversation fences and actual Service leaf-registry callbacks. New opt-in Core test-support helper exposes existing attach/tick/clear only; ordinary builds have no helper or changed mixer behavior. Connect Service test-support enables it.
proof_design: Create a real isolated Store Conversation with two identities and acquire its complete identity/Conversation read footprint in synthetic media leases. Negotiate two actual PCMU staged controllers and prove actual mixer output before contention.

Only scene.tick runs while armed. Trigger when a queued source admission observes another source lease still owned by that tick; hold the real Service entries registry and start an actual complete Store writer with the production5ms acquisition budget.

In the controlled comparison arm, call the existing Service fresh-ingress10ms callback under that registry. Require authority-busy writer failure and at least8ms callback occupancy. This selects a counterfactual callback; it is not a historical-binary run.

In the queued arm, call actual Service current_queued under the same contention. Require writer success under its unchanged5ms deadline, one contended callback, tick below50ms and no held source reader after tick.
Join the writer, clear the scene, shut down actual controllers and require complete Store writer acquisition after cleanup.
checks_pending: Compile on the local Ubuntu24 ARM VM with pinned patch281 sources and connect-service/test-support.
Run only the one new exact case; no existing suite or full media workload.
limitations: Core relationship facts and adapter resources are synthetic. Store fences and Service refusal callback are actual, but the positive lease is not a NativeMediaRead and the writer does not run captured replacement SQL.
A pass establishes the controlled mixer/Store contention mechanism; it cannot attribute all449ms in the original workload or qualify native media quality.
No native cancellation/Data observer fault, video bootstrap, authenticated epoch or full transport cell proof.
